does: Takes one bound object off one tile of the AI grid: finds the subgrid by the tile's id, clears the object's grid flags from the tile and drops the object from the tile's metadata.

evidence.says: write watch (GK.Memory.Watch, 8 bytes) on the AiFlags of an AI grid tile in TestLevel_Tom (tile 38,84 under a placed door; tile 34,81 under a created barrel), the tile reached from Bound+0x18 -> AiGrid -> Subgrids (+0x68) -> AiSubgrid.TileGrid (+0x30): hit at +0xE38E62 on Osi.Open of the door (the bits 0x100 and 0xC00000 - ShootBlockItem, Door, DoorItemBlock - cleared, read back by Ext.Level.GetTileDebugInfo) and on each refresh after a barrel's creation; return chain eoc::BoundComponent::Decrease < eoc::AiGrid::RemoveObject < esv::Item::UpdateBoundFlags; decomp code read
